name: KrispCall
description_en:
KrispCall is a cloud business-phone platform for calls,SMS,voicemail,shared-number work and CRM-linked conversations. Its Unified Callbox collects conversation history,notes,tags and call controls in one workspace. The current commercial plans are Starter,Advance,Max and custom Enterprise;older Essential/Standard wording in service terms is not treated as a verified mapping to those plans.

An illustrative support team could open a customer conversation from My Number,review prior notes,return a call and mark the conversation closed. Outbound teams can separately evaluate the beta Power Dialer,but its traffic is excluded from ordinary included-call allowances under the FUP. No account,number,KYC,call,message,dialer,CRM connection,payment,refund or export was executed.
description_zh:
KrispCall是云商务电话平台，处理电话、短信、语音信箱、共享号码及关联CRM会话。Unified Callbox将会话历史、备注、标签及电话控制集中在一个工作区。当前商业方案为Starter、Advance、Max及定制Enterprise，服务条款旧Essential／Standard名称不当作与当前方案的已核映射。

假设支持团队可从My Number打开客户会话，查旧备注、回拨并标记关闭。外呼团队可另评估Beta Power Dialer，但FUP将其流量排除普通包含通话额度。未执行账户、号码、KYC、电话、消息、拨号器、CRM连接、付款、退款或导出。

core_features.explanation_en: Review calls,SMS,voicemail,recordings,notes and tags with open/closed conversation status.
core_features.explanation_zh: 结合开／关会话状态查看电话、短信、信箱、录音、备注和标签。

core_features.explanation_en: Apply DND to a contact or number and use search,filters,pins and blocking to organize follow-up.
core_features.explanation_zh: 按联系人或号码免打扰，用查询、过滤、置顶及屏蔽组织跟进。

core_features.explanation_en: Build prioritized campaign lists and scripts;confirm pacing and separately billed usage before scaling.
core_features.explanation_zh: 建按优先级名单和脚本，扩量前确认节奏及独立计费用量。

core_features.name_zh: 按方案限定合资格额度
core_features.explanation_en: FUP defines pooled eligible manual usage with destination/rate limits and excludes automation.
core_features.explanation_zh: FUP定义合资格用量汇总、目的地／费率限制，并排除自动化。

en: A small support or remote team organizing calls,SMS and voicemail around shared customer context.
A sales team evaluating a separately scoped dialer and CRM workflow instead of assuming unlimited campaign usage.
zh: 按共享客户上下文组织电话、短信及信箱的小型支持或远程团队。
单独评估拨号器及CRM流程，而非假设活动流量无限的销售团队。
use_cases.basis: Editorial fit,not measured productivity,deliverability or customer outcomes.

Platform scope.en: Cloud service with web/mobile access and browser extension. Pricing labels transcript/summary as an add-on and lists some capabilities as coming soon;not all navigation labels are verified live entitlements.
Platform scope.zh: 云服务提供网页／移动访问及浏览器扩展，价格页将转录／摘要列附加项，部分能力标即将提供，不能把全部导航标签当已上线权益。

steps.en: Choose the plan,card-backed billing cycle,number country/type,document requirements and separate dialer/AI usage scope.
steps.zh: 选择方案、需卡付费周期、号码国家／类型、文件要求及独立拨号器／AI用量范围。

steps.en: Configure one number and permitted test contact;review Callbox history,notes,DND and open/closed status.
steps.zh: 配置一个号码和获准测试联系人，检查会话箱历史、备注、免打扰和开／关状态。

steps.en: Compare one call/message result with eligible-usage accounting and any CRM write;verify export and cancellation before depending on retention.
steps.zh: 比对一通电话／消息结果、合资格用量和CRM写入，依赖留存前核对导出及取消。

items.en: Power Dialer,bulk messaging,workflow and bot traffic do not consume ordinary included benefits;standard charges apply under FUP.
items.zh: Power Dialer、群发、流程和机器人流量不使用普通包含权益，FUP称按标准费计。

items.en: New plan cards/FUP show included usage while pricing FAQ still says all calls/SMS are separate PAYG. Inbound threshold also differs at exactly0.025USD/minute.
items.zh: 新卡片／FUP列含用量，价格FAQ仍称全部电话／短信另按量计；恰好0.025USD／分钟的呼入阈值也不同。

items.en: Fourteen days is a conditional refund-request window,not a free trial or automatically refundable carrier usage.
items.zh: 14天是有条件申请退款窗口，不是免费试用或自动退运营商用量。

items.en: Max unlimited benefits are described as normal business use,not high-volume call-centre use;actual campaign capacity requires agreement.
items.zh: Max无限权益描述为普通企业用法，不用于高量联络中心，实际活动容量需协议。

items.en: Refund policy says account data is deleted at the nearest billing date after cancellation;complete export and restoration remain unverified.
items.zh: 退款政策称取消后在最近计费日删除账户资料，完整导出及恢复未核。

license.notes_zh: 受限可撤销、非独占、不可转移或再许可访问权，厂商保留知识产权；提及开源组件不使整个托管服务开源。

pricing.source_snapshot_zh: 实际USD界面Starter年付折月12／月付15（至多五用户），Advance32／40（至多50），Max48／60（无人数限），年付预付。Enterprise询价50+量价不是通用最低量。无免费方案／试用，需卡，14天仅订阅退款且有排除。卡片／FUP Starter每月200呼出+200呼入+100短信，Advance1000+1000+500，Max合资格无限加1000短信，按账户汇总。FAQ又称全部按量，FUP呼入严格<.025与价格<=.025不同。Power／群发／机器人／流程排除，AI转录／摘要附加。每用户合资格美加英号码，其他号码／电话另计，美迁号免费其他可收费。

faq.question_en: Is the14day offer a free trial?
faq.answer_en: No. Pricing explicitly says no free plan or trial and requires a payment card. It advertises a subscription refund window,whose separate policy has exclusions and a request process.
faq.answer_zh: 不是。价格页明确无免费方案／试用且需付款卡，宣传订阅退款窗口，独立政策有排除和申请流程。

faq.question_en: Can Max unlimited cover Power Dialer campaigns?
faq.answer_en: The FUP explicitly excludes Power Dialer and automated/bot traffic from included benefits. Max is described as ordinary business usage,not high-volume call-centre use. Confirm a separate rate and workload scope.
faq.answer_zh: FUP明确将Power及自动化／机器人流量排除包含权益，Max描述普通企业而非高量联络中心用法，需另确认费率及负载范围。

official_check.scope: Public vendor documentation reviewed; no account execution, purchase, owner identity, independent review or publication approval.

review_notes: Vendor descriptions are documentation evidence, not independent reliability, usability or customer-outcome verification.
English and Chinese are paired drafts. Chinese text does not establish Chinese UI support.
All alternative relationships remain unreviewed. Public-web retrieval may use cached content; prices are dated observations.

sections.title_en: A conversation workspace is not a completed CRM workflow
sections.title_zh: 会话工作区不等于已完成CRM流程
sections.en:
Unified Callbox collects calls,SMS,MMS,voicemails,recordings,notes and tags around customer conversations. The documented path is to open My Number and select a contacted number,then review the history. Users can pin contacts,search and filter,mark conversations open/closed,and set DND for one contact or an entire number. These controls help a team organize follow-up,but a closed conversation is not proof that a customer issue was resolved or a CRM transaction succeeded.

For an illustrative missed-call follow-up,check the correct contact,prior notes,callback result and saved disposition before closing. Shared-number visibility,private team messages and customer messages need separate permission checks. The site names many CRM connectors,but exact field mapping,retries,historical backfill and cross-workspace access were not tested. A product page promising never to miss a conversation is not a completeness guarantee.
sections.zh:
Unified Callbox围绕客户会话汇集电话、短信、彩信、信箱、录音、备注及标签，文档路径为打开My Number，再选联系过的号码查看历史。可置顶、查询过滤、标开／关，以及对联系人或整个号码免打扰。这有助组织跟进，但会话关闭不证明客户问题解决或CRM事务成功。

假设未接来电跟进需检查正确联系人、旧备注、回拨结果及保存处置，再关闭。共享号码可见性、内部私信及客户消息需分别查权限。官网列许多CRM连接器，但未测字段映射、重试、历史回填及跨工作区访问；宣传不错过会话不是完整性保证。

sections.title_en: Power Dialer has a separate traffic and readiness boundary
sections.title_zh: Power Dialer有独立流量及就绪边界
sections.en:
The Power Dialer page is labelled Beta and describes prioritized lists,campaign scripts,CRM context,skipping unanswered calls and voicemail functions. Its wording mixes automation of a series with multiple or simultaneous calls;it does not establish a precise one-line pacing contract,wrap-up period or abandoned-call denominator. Claims of100%accuracy were not adopted.

More decisively,the September2026FUP excludes Power Dialer,bulk messages,workflow automation and bots from included calling/SMS benefits. Standard rates apply to those uses. The Max plan’s unlimited allowance is intended for normal business communications and explicitly not high-volume call-centre use. A team should test list consent,suppression,wrong/machine answers,no available agent and the resulting usage charges before scaling a campaign. The presence of a dialer in a paid plan does not make its minutes free.
sections.zh:
Power Dialer页标Beta，描述按优先名单、活动脚本、CRM上下文、跳过无人接及信箱功能。措辞混合连续自动化与多通／同时电话，未建立精确单线节奏、整理期或弃接分母，未采用100%准确主张。

更明确的是2026年九月FUP将Power、群发、流程及机器人排除包含电话／短信权益，按标准费收费。Max无限用于普通企业通信，明确非高量联络中心。扩活动前应测名单联系许可、屏蔽、错接／答录机、无客服及用量费用；付费方案有拨号器不代表分钟免费。

sections.title_en: Use actual seat prices and preserve contradictory usage wording
sections.title_zh: 使用实际座席价，并保留用量措辞冲突
sections.en:
The browser pricing interface showed USD Starter12,Advance32and Max48per user/month when billed annually,and15,40and60when monthly was selected. Starter supports up to five users,Advance up to fifty,and Max has no member limit. Enterprise offers negotiated volume pricing for50+seats;the FAQ separately says no minimum,so50+is not treated here as a universal minimum purchase. Annual prices are prepaid equivalents rather than cancel-anytime monthly payments.

Current cards and the FUP show pooled monthly eligible allowances:Starter200outbound minutes,200inbound and100SMS segments per user;Advance1000,1000and500;Max eligible unlimited calls and1000SMS. Yet the same pricing FAQ and calculator say calls/SMS are separately billed PAYG. Do not silently choose one statement to calculate an all-in price. Transcript/summary is marked an add-on,and additional numbers,registration,automation and excluded destinations can add costs. No purchase or invoice verified which wording governs an actual account.
sections.zh:
浏览器价格界面在年付时显示USD Starter12、Advance32、Max48，每用户每月；选择月付后为15、40、60。Starter至多五用户，Advance至多50，Max无限人数。Enterprise提供50+座席协商量价，但FAQ又说无最低量，因此不把50+当通用最低购买量。年付数字是预付折算，不是随时取消的月付款。

当前卡片及FUP列每用户按月汇总合资格额度：Starter呼出200分钟、呼入200、短信100段，Advance1000／1000／500，Max合资格无限电话及1000短信。但同页FAQ和计算器又称电话／短信另按量计，不能静默选一种计算全包价。转录／摘要标附加项，额外号码、注册、自动化及排除目的地可能加费。未购买或查账单确定真实账户适用表述。

sections.title_en: Check destinations,rate thresholds and billing pulses
sections.title_zh: 核对目的地、费率阈值及计费脉冲
sections.en:
The FUP scopes eligible outbound minutes to US/Canada and local numbers in UK/Australia;UK/Australia mobiles are not included. It scopes inbound to rates strictly below USD0.025per minute,while the pricing card says0.025or less. The equality case is unresolved. Usage pools at account level,resets monthly even for annual subscriptions,and unused benefits do not roll over. Forwarding,trunking,toll-free/special destinations and automation are excluded.

The FUP says a started call consumes at least one minute even without voice transfer,and partial minutes round upward. That is broader than charging only for meaningful connected conversation. US/Canada SMS benefits require approved registration;the policy says unregistered blocked messages can still count. These are vendor commercial conditions,not independent statements of carrier law or universal SMS encoding. Obtain the actual rate card,approved campaign and failure-charge rules rather than equating failed delivery with zero cost.
sections.zh:
FUP将合资格呼出限美加及英澳本地号码，不含英澳移动号码；呼入限费率严格低于USD0.025／分钟，而卡片说0.025或以下，等于阈值时未解决。用量按账户汇总，即使年订阅也每月重置，未用不结转。转发、线路转接、免费／特殊号码及自动化排除。

FUP称发起电话即至少一分钟，即使没语音传输，零碎分钟向上取整，比只按有效接通会话收费更广。美加短信权益需注册获批，政策称未注册被拦仍可计数。这是厂商商业条件，不是运营商法律或通用短信编码的独立结论。需取得真实费率表、获批活动及失败收费规则，不能把送达失败等同零成本。

sections.title_en: A refund window does not remove cancellation and export work
sections.title_zh: 退款窗口不免除取消和导出工作
sections.en:
Pricing explicitly says there is no free plan or free trial and requires a card. Fourteen days refers to subscription refunds. The older separate refund policy requires a request and lists exclusions such as carrier usage,credits,assigned numbers,new members and mid-month cancellation. Its conditional process conflicts with unconditional marketing,so this profile promises no automatic full refund. Bulk/API add-on subscriptions can be managed separately and require a separate cancellation request.

The refund policy says account data is deleted at the nearest billing date after cancellation. Export recordings,logs,notes and contact data before canceling;complete portable export and restoration were not established. Number porting is free for US local/toll-free numbers on the pricing page,while other countries may involve fees/documents. Numbers remain rented resources under the service terms,not owned assets. The EULA grants restricted,revocable software access;open-source components do not make the platform open source.
sections.zh:
价格页明确无免费方案或免费试用，需卡；14天指订阅退款。较旧独立退款政策要求申请，列运营商用量、余额、已分配号码、新成员及月中取消等排除。这个有条件流程与无条件宣传冲突，因此本档案不承诺自动全退；批量／API附加订阅可独立管理，需另申请取消。

退款政策称取消后在最近计费日删账户资料，应先导出录音、日志、备注及联系人，尚未建立完整可携导出或恢复。价格页仅美本地／免费号码迁移免费，其他国家可需收费／文件。服务条款下号码是租用资源而非自有资产；EULA授予有限可撤销软件访问，含开源组件不使平台开源。

sections.title_en: Match the operating workload to confirmed capabilities
sections.title_zh: 将运营负载匹配已确认能力
sections.en:
KrispCall is an editorial candidate for teams needing shared call/SMS history and structured follow-up. A larger automated outbound floor needs separate commercial and capacity confirmation. Public navigation labels AI Voice Agent as coming soon;the Power Dialer page remains Beta,and pricing marks transcription/summary as an add-on. These states should not be collapsed into an already tested autonomous contact centre.

Before adoption,verify the exact plan,number verification,recording access,AI handling,connector scope and export path. Browser observations establish displayed prices,not reliability or account entitlements. The general service terms still use legacy plan names,another reason to obtain a current order-specific scope. UI languages,data regions,recording retention,actual API/webhook readiness and independent security/performance results remain unverified.
sections.zh:
编辑判断KrispCall可供需要共享电话／短信历史及结构化跟进的团队评估，较大自动外呼团队需另确认商业及容量。公开导航将AI Voice Agent标即将提供，Power页仍Beta，价格页转录／摘要标附加项，不能合并成已测试自主联络中心。

采用前需验证真实方案、号码核验、录音访问、AI处理、连接器及导出路径。浏览器观察只建立展示价格，不建立可靠性或账户权益。通用条款仍用旧方案名，更需当前订单范围。界面语言、资料地区、录音留存、API／Webhook真实就绪及独立安全／性能结果仍未核。
